discoveryRequests.query: Capabilities and contracts for creating a self-contained chat-agent workflow that can clone a GitHub PR once into a fixed workspace directory, run dependency install/lint/unit/integration tests, use GitHub Copilot for code review, post diff comments and an approve/request-changes/reject review on GitHub, and always delete the cloned repository directory at the end.

GitHub API operations/contracts for reading pull request metadata and changed files/diffs, creating pull request review comments on diff lines, and submitting an approve/request-changes/comment review decision.
Git repository workflow operations/contracts for cloning a GitHub repository/pull request into a single fixed local directory and checking out the PR head for analysis.

Code project operations/contracts using GitHub Copilot suggestions for dependency installation, lint/test discovery and execution, integration tests when present, and adaptive code review within a fixed workspace directory.
